name: Autonomy Labs Storefront
description: AI-agent-discoverable storefront: browse a machine-readable catalog of 43 products, buy digital downloads by card via Stripe Checkout, or commission a browser prototype. Free agent-readiness audit API included.

endpoints.description: Full product catalog (Schema.org ItemList): 43 products with names, prices in EUR, categories, and per-product Stripe Checkout payment links.
Agent-friendly catalog index: products, prices, buy links, free tools, blog.
Full agent documentation: every product with buy + landing URLs, purchase flow, agent interoperability notes.

Free AI-agent readiness audit for any website. Returns JSON: grade (A-D), score, per-surface checks across eight surfaces (robots.txt, sitemap.xml, llms.txt, llms-full.txt, agents.txt, .well-known/x402, .well-known/agents.json, .well-known/security.txt).
A2A protocol agent card (0.2.1): machine-readable identity, skills, and resources for agent-to-agent discovery.

workflows.description: Buy a digital product (43-item catalog incl. 12 complete HTML5 games), or commission a service: read the catalog, pick a Stripe Checkout payment link, and pay by card. Downloads are delivered by webhook; made-to-order services follow their stated delivery windows.

steps.name: pick-product
steps.action: read the product's offers.url (buy.stripe.com payment link)

steps.name: checkout
steps.action: open the payment link; customer pays by card via Stripe Checkout

steps.name: delivery
steps.action: checkout.session.completed webhook emails digital downloads; made-to-order services follow the product delivery window

workflows.description: Grade any website's AI-agent discoverability for free, then optionally order the deep €19 audit report.

steps.name: deep-audit-option
steps.action: if a deeper evidence-backed report is wanted, buy the AI Website Audit Report (€19) and enter the URL at checkout
